content:
The image shows a severely desiccated, shriveled, brown/dead twig or shoot tip. The tissue is completely dry and necrotic, twisted and withered from the tip downward — classic shoot tip dieback.

Key observations:
- Affected part: shoot/stem tip
- Color: uniform dark brown, completely dead tissue
- Texture: dry, shriveled, twisted
- Pattern: necrosis progressing from the tip downward
- No powdery coating (rules out Powdery_Mildew)
- No black sooty layer (rules out Sooty_Mould)
- No lesions with defined margins typical of Anthracnose
- The shoot has died back from the tip — hallmark of Die_Back disease
